question: Are the tests rigorous enough for the full architecture?
answer: No broad production or superiority claim is supported. This slice must establish one explicit role-origin human decision and same-work native continuation with real actors and independent evidence.

layers.mechanical: Real PG/schema/routing and current role revision/ownership checks, original immutable receipts, no auth-source fallback. Not semantic model proof.
layers.actualModels: Each cohort uses real independent LAX agents with reader/writer/responder histories. Frozen ordinary initial task then actual peer release. Human Q/A via authenticated user API. No semantic fixture acting in place of models.
layers.output: Independent strict canonical JSON and native-owner CLI probes with unseen/invalid cases and deliberately wrong-output control. Root-readable file success alone is insufficient.
layers.audience: Actual A/B history projections all/conversation/activity, exact question/answer visibility and private canary. Not merely checking conversation body or raw DB.
layers.causality: Actual original Attention.response_event, exact source/authority, same Work update, input handled, no answer Work, original claim/generation/history preserved.
layers.recovery: Only observed original known cancellation settlement and same-history new responsibility. Unknown outcomes or generic crash recovery are not extrapolated.
layers.reporting: All setup/model/driver attempts retained. r252 and r253 frozen failures remain failures; supplemental audit is labeled, fresh cohort is a separate trial.

unqualified: Natural semantic relevance across varied business tasks and realistic room traffic
General goal-development adoption and exact reviewed-definition/evidence binding
Role-origin native Goal plus real multi-room peer work/cooperative editing end state
Statistical reliability, costs and causal superiority against a capable single-context baseline
Install/upgrade repeatability across enterprises, multi-host/phone/voice/push and actual OZZZ business delivery
nextPriority: One coherent native role-to-goal-to-peer-work delivery with a reviewed success definition; source review before changes. Do not turn every failure into a new architecture or branch of unrelated testing.
